args.query_or_mutation: query CoralSwarmIssuesChanged($since: DateTimeOrDuration!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { issues(filter: { updatedAt: { gte: $since } }, orderBy: updatedAt, first: $first, after: $after, includeArchived: true) { nodes { id identifier title description createdAt updatedAt state { name } creator { id name } project { id name } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

query CoralSwarmCommentsChanged($since: DateTimeOrDuration!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { comments(filter: { updatedAt: { gte: $since }, issue: { null: false } }, orderBy: updatedAt, first: $first, after: $after, includeArchived: true) { nodes { id body createdAt updatedAt user { id name } issue { id title identifier project { id name } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

query CoralSwarmProjectsChanged($since: DateTimeOrDuration!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { projects(filter: { updatedAt: { gte: $since } }, orderBy: updatedAt, first: $first, after: $after, includeArchived: true) { nodes { id name description updatedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

limits.coverage: every issue, comment and project the connected account can read, workspace-wide, changed after you connect
limits.history: nothing from before you connect is imported
limits.description_history: each captured change keeps the previous version as evidence
limits.state_history: states observed at each change; transitions between polls are not reconstructed
limits.archives: archived issues, comments and projects are included when they change
limits.documents: Linear documents and project updates are not captured
